domains.note: Fumbl owns no domain yet. fumbl.commandagi.app is the primary address, in English. A country code is a translation-specific deployment of the same site; a generic TLD is an alias of the primary. `commandagi sites domains fumbl add <domain>` prints the CNAME and TXT records; the DNS is the owner's, and nothing is added here until a domain exists.
domains.genericTldRule: an alias of the primary: it serves the primary locale, en
